purpose: Place the Cambioni et al. (2022) ALMA longitude/latitude grids, defined in the Shepard et al. (2021) body frame, on the ADAM mesh whose frame the LAM spin parameter file defines.

epoch.source: Midpoint of the ALMA observations, 2019 June 19 06:33:12 to 09:11:13 UT: de Kleer, Cambioni & Shepard (2021), PSJ 2, 149, section 2 and Table 1, arXiv:2105.11372.

timeScales.source: TAI-UTC = 37 s from 2017 January 1 (IERS Bulletin C) plus TT-TAI = 32.184 s; TDB-TT is below 2 ms and is neglected.

grid.frame: Shepard et al. (2021) body frame: +x on the major axis (longitude 0), +z on the positive spin pole, east-positive longitude
grid.source: Cambioni, de Kleer & Shepard (2022), JGR Planets, e2021JE007091, doi:10.1029/2021JE007091, section 2.3, equation 2 (theta1 = 36 deg, theta2 = -8 deg, phi0 = 341.56 deg at J2000) and period 4.195948 h (Shepard et al. 2021, PSJ 2, 125, Table 5), arXiv:2402.03422.

mesh.frame: ADAM mesh body frame of the VLT/SPHERE survey release
mesh.source: LAM release parameter file, read as the SPHERE photograph lens reads it (tools/objects/observer-cameras.mts).
